sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
📖 Your old life taught you things. 5 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Brass Locket, Coat button, Carpenter's square, Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 2). Falling pressure = weather coming. Your joints ache? That's a barometer. So are the birds — silent birds mean storm.
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 2). Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 2). Reverse-wrap technique makes rope strong enough to hold weight. Braid for more strength.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 2). Edges are the grocery store — where meadow meets woods, where water meets bank. Disturbed ground regrows first and fattest.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Grayson Berger. Farmer. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Trail compass, Brass Locket, Dog tags, Hoodie, Knife roll. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing
A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
When the pot tipped and scalded Mara's hand, everyone flinched — except Grayson, who smiled. Just a beat too long. You covered it by fetching water, quick and helpful.
People will notice: smiles a beat too long when someone gets hurt. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
